model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, int4 gs64 experts (qwen36 container), 23.03 GB, HF Kreuzzelg/qwen36-35b-a3b-colibri-i4-gs64
command: baseline: git worktree at 5cfb55bd, trial: b591acb1; make -C c qwen36 OMPDIR=$HOME/libomp-static (clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp); per run: env -u OMP_NUM_THREADS -u OMP_DYNAMIC SNAP=$HOME/models/qwen36_i4_gs64 N_NEW=16 COLI_TIMERS=1 /usr/bin/time -l ./qwen36 2 4 prompt.txt; order base x3, trial x3, trial x3, base x3
